ladder.registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

ladder.registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluator_work.registration_source: G0 measurements and P2 normalization freeze outstanding
G0 measurements and P2 normalization freeze outstanding

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.

evaluation.budget_registration_source: Quarantined discrimination-first scenario measurements; never acceptance or confirmatory evidence. L0 runs as validity-only (plan 3.3: L0 demotes to a validity filter if it cannot rank): its analytical snapshot replay estimates end-to-end latency without the queueing dynamics that decide feasibility on this family, so under the retightened SLO it marks every candidate infeasible and cannot rank. L1 keeps the full 420 s horizon on one seed and one bundle because a truncated horizon would sit inside the published 182 s fog wake latency and model a different regime from L2. L2 runs one scenario seed x three bundles per EVAL_NOISE.md (the fixed-work optimum); finalists are re-scored on a fresh multi-seed grid rather than the selection grid. L1 rejects candidates whose summed primitive shortfall exceeds 1.0, which drops the catastrophically infeasible shapes (most_allocated-like, summed shortfall > 3) before they buy a full L2 while keeping near-boundary candidates rankable; the ladder epsilon-audit re-checks a 0.1 fraction.
